soft_issues: Without its game label, the clock-tower composition could also read as a large school or town hall.
Classical architecture alone does not uniquely distinguish a museum from a civic hall; banners and label carry the precise role.
Seating rings have less left/right light modulation than the architectural props; their material separation communicates the form more strongly than lighting.
false_positives: Stadium pillow-shading detection arises from repeated material rings and a dark structural perimeter; independently inspected at native and 4x and not confirmed as concentric shading.
reasoning: Reviewed the landmark contact sheet, every 128x128 native source, separate nearest-neighbor 4x images, and the classic/SF exported atlases. All four entrances are visible and unobstructed, and the palette/outline/glass treatment matches the existing 64px building set. Larger buildings use additional native-size detail units rather than simply enlarging small sprites. Independent checker runs reproduce scores 100/100/100/50; the stadium issue is retained and adjudicated below. Targeted palette follow-up inspected rebaked New York and San Francisco atlases: pitch lines, floodlight panels and university clock faces remain pale and readable, with no brick/purple tint obscuring these semantic details. Native images were unchanged, so native checker findings remain applicable.
optional_polish: If stronger stadium depth is desired, add a restrained existing-palette shadow on the lower-right outer stand wall without changing the colors of the pitch or track markings.
Use the game labels to disambiguate museum and university rather than adding tiny illegible text to their facades.

assets.warning_adjudication: Pillow warning is a false positive. Alternating red/cream oval bands are discrete stand/track materials around a differently colored green pitch, not a monotonically brighter inward luminance ramp. Gatehouse, perimeter and scoreboard outlines are structural dark shapes. The central pitch is not a symmetric luminous highlight; no verified pillow shading is visible.
